name: Glass code review suggestion applied
oneLiner: a code editor on glass with one line flagged: a review thread opens under it with a suggested change in red and green, Apply suggestion is clicked and turns green, the line retypes itself as the fix and flushes green, then the thread folds into a Suggestion applied line
say: when the speaker says the AI reviewed the code and suggested a fix ('it left one comment, I hit apply and it was fixed', 'the reviewer caught it'): the thread opens on 'it suggested', the line rewrites on 'apply'
